_description: Earth's OSCULATING orbit against its MEAN — GENERATED by tools/verify/earth-osculating-wobble.js --write. A drawing for the Framework Verification panel ("Perihelion — osculating vs mean"), not a model input: nothing reads it but the panel. verdict: the window mean of (osculating − mean) — the series IS the mean element, so this is a consistency check of the lab's physics against the run's — and Mercury's semi-major-axis drift (the integrator's energy).
